Offline analysis worker gpt-6-astra xhigh per user's model instruction. Workspace /home/regex/work/esp32s31-openvela. Read root README and applicable AGENTS plus xts-board-evidence skill. Root sole hardware/UART/USB/Windows/network/credentials owner. NO functional code, tests/builds, downloads/upgrades, git switches/cleanup, hardware or subagents. Write only backups/xts-adaptation-and-test-evidence/korvo-default-reference-followup/fs-maintained-integration-plan.md and compact selected-input-hashes.json if helpful. Do not read active UDP run/journal or private paths.

FS qfs01, qfs02 and qfs03 are finished/restored. Frozen qualification reports under korvo-fs-default-qualification: first-board-review/statistics, second-board-review, third-board-review, root-third-board-review.json and root-third-board-restoration.json. All 8 matched FS comparison rates above fixedE90; stop FS tuning. QFSfullbytes/remount/COW/8streams and originalsmall/performance/dd complete. qfs03 original5thread×1000 printedTESTPASS/prompt butstrictprogressparser rejectedSMPinterleaving; postthreadresources/cleanup/quiet notcaptured. Read qfs03-thread-result-contract-review.md. NO fourth standalone cycle solely for log formatting, no E90/comparison/COW repeat. Prior cost-disposition-review.md retains E75WEL and correctedE97window with explicit memory/read/probe costs; pagepool32rejected duewear.

Need concrete NEXT implementation plan for bringing these frozen FS deltas into the actual maintained openvela tree, then verifying remaining resource/coexistence gaps in that integration. Existing fs-qualification-next-step.md already establishes ancestry; do not restart broad investigation or merely restate it. Read actual maintained target file contents/configs/build entrances and Git states at real repo roots, preserve all dirty changes; source paths under openvela-dev may be multi-repo and apps/tests symlink. Scope only FS-related selected deltas (safeLittleFS/VFScoalescing/pagepool, E84/E97correctedstdio, exactE75WEL) and current formal Korvo config. Determine exact files/base mismatches/conflicts and whether upstream/vendor/module constraints require isolated integration staging first. No broad source-copy or new cleanbuild yet; no merge of unrelated visual/demo/submission trees. Identify which frozen deltas are absent/already present/conflict, functional dependencies/config/cost budget, minimal patch ownership/maintainability boundaries. Avoid blindly copying diagnostic/qualification app/instrumentation into production or weakening locks/cache/IRQ/WEL/durability/security.

Network new disjoint-copy candidate is LIVE under Root now and not adopted; do NOT mix it speculatively. Plan must explicitly gate which network branch enters combined image after its own result. Achieved TCP32 remains; UDP/PS/11ax gaps remain separate. Missing FS resources should be collected in the planned combined/integration run without claiming previousnativePASS fixes those observations. Future capture must record postresources/ownedfiles even if nativeprogress parsing rejects, preserve failure, no fabricatedpass. Do not write this code now.

Deliver concise actionable integration handoff with exact source/config/build inputs, risks/conflicts, needed focused regression versus reusable evidence, and next Sol implementation boundary. No workload/time estimates, no new permission or expansion into platform/media. Root should be able to execute next step from your report. Selected hash checks only, no247k-tree or allupstreamaudit. Stop after report; send concrete blockers promptly.
我会按离线范围核对维护树、冻结补丁和构建入口，使用 `xts-board-evidence` 技能整理可直接交给 Sol 的集成计划。只写指定报告及必要的输入哈希，不接触硬件、活动 UDP 记录或功能代码。
冻结结论已确认：qfs03 的原程序 PASS 与严格解析失败必须并列保留，缺失的线程后资源和清理观察只能由后续集成运行补齐。维护目录采用多个独立 Git 仓库，`apps/tests` 还是符号链接；接下来按真实仓库归属核对补丁，避免整树复制。
发现两个会影响集成的具体问题：维护树已经含 E84 的绝对 seek 优化，但缺少 corrected E97、共享 VFS/页池及 E75；冻结 Flash 文件还依赖维护树尚未具备的安全映射读路径。另一个问题是 LittleFS 有独立 Git 仓库，而 CMake/Make 的下载兜底版本不同；必须先在隔离暂存区明确版本和补丁归属，不能直接覆盖文件后构建。

补丁边界已收敛。安全 LittleFS 的堆归属、缓存覆盖写、路径修复和 E84 均已在维护树的脏改动中，应保留；新增部分集中在 native LittleFS 两文件、VFS/页池、九个 stdio 文件及 Flash/MMU 构建适配。冻结树把 staging 默认改成 256，而维护树刻意保留 64 默认；计划会只在目标 Korvo 配置显式选 256，并标出 Make 路径缺失的 MMU 保护/释放编译定义。
报告已写入，正在核对路径和交付范围。下一步边界是先交付隔离的按仓库补丁、依赖固定记录和配置差异，再由 Root 的网络结果决定组合镜像；不会把正在运行的 UDP 候选预先纳入，也不会为 qfs03 的日志交错安排独立重跑。

Wrote the [integration handoff](/home/regex/work/esp32s31-openvela/backups/xts-adaptation-and-test-evidence/korvo-default-reference-followup/fs-maintained-integration-plan.md) and [selected hashes](/home/regex/work/esp32s31-openvela/backups/xts-adaptation-and-test-evidence/korvo-default-reference-followup/selected-input-hashes.json).

Key findings: E84 and several safe fixes already exist; integration needs separate LittleFS ownership, missing MMU build adaptations, and explicit Korvo configuration. The plan gates network adoption and carries resource gaps into combined validation while preserving parser failures.

Only the two permitted files were written. No code, tests, builds or hardware actions.
